topic: Green Bridge data model release plan
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the readiness and timing of releasing the Green Bridge data. [p1] presented an approximate model for the City category, which is available via a staging analytics dashboard link. [p1] stated they are currently verifying factors for cars and buses and proposed discussing this verification process later that day.

Multiple participants agreed on the urgency to release the data today. If a full release was not possible, it was necessary to proactively inform the client of the postponement.
decisions: The Green Bridge model is planned for release today.
A final check must be completed before the model can be released.
action_items: [p1] will book a meeting later today to discuss the car and bus factor verification process.
